window.busy: Wait until the installation is done

install.title: Install Bookeeper

icons.both: Icon on the desktop and in the Start menu

install.autostart: Opens when you sign in to Windows

customize.title: Customize

problem.needs_admin: This folder needs administrator rights. Pick one in your user folder.
problem.network: Pick a folder on this computer.
problem.not_absolute: Pick a folder on this computer.
problem.too_long: The path is too long. Pick a folder closer to the top of the drive.
problem.too_little_space: This drive is too full: {free} left.
problem.temp_too_small: The drive for temporary files is too full: {free} left.
problem.unknown: I can’t check this folder. Pick another one.

customize.startMenu: Bookeeper is always in the Start menu: Windows notifications need it.
customize.autostart: Open Bookeeper when you sign in to Windows
customize.autostartNote: It opens minimized. If you share your library on the network, phones can find it while the computer is on.

done.whereBoth: Find it on the desktop and in the Start menu.
done.whereStart: Find it in the Start menu.

running.title: Close Bookeeper to continue
running.text: The app is open on this computer. Close it, then press “Try again”.

error.text: Try again. If it stops again, copy the details and send them to whoever helps you.

older.title: Update Bookeeper
older.text: This computer has version {installed}. Version {version} leaves your library as it is, in the same folder.

same.title: Bookeeper {version} is already installed
same.text: You can repair it if something is wrong, or uninstall it.

newer.title: A newer version is already here
newer.text: This computer has version {installed}. A library from version {installed} does not open in version {version}: to go back, uninstall with “Delete everything”.

legacy.title: This version is very old
legacy.text: This computer has Bookeeper {installed}. Uninstall it from Settings › Apps, then open Setup again.

incomplete.title: The downloaded file is incomplete
incomplete.text: Download it again, then open Setup again.

elevated.title: Open Setup without administrator rights
elevated.text: Bookeeper installs for your user. Close this window and open Setup with a double click.

unsupported.title: This Setup is for Windows
unsupported.text: On this system, install Bookeeper with the right package.

keep.title: Keep your library
keep.text: Books, covers and backups stay on this computer. If you reinstall, they are still there.
keep.textEbooks: Books, covers, e-books and backups stay on this computer. If you reinstall, they are still there.
keep.textRemote: Links to libraries on servers stay on this computer. If you reinstall, they are still there.

delete.title: Delete everything
delete.text: Also removes the library on this computer: {size}, with covers and backups.
delete.textEbooks: Also removes the library on this computer: {size}, with covers, e-books and backups.
delete.textRemote: Also removes the data saved on this computer: {size}, with links to libraries on servers.

confirm.title: Delete the whole library?
confirm.text: Books, covers and automatic backups will be gone from this computer: {size}. This cannot be undone.
confirm.textEbooks: Books, covers, e-books and automatic backups will be gone from this computer: {size}. This cannot be undone.
confirm.textRemote: Links to libraries and saved data will be gone from this computer: {size}. This cannot be undone.
confirm.note: Libraries on a server stay where they are.

removed.title: Bookeeper is uninstalled
removed.kept: Your library is still on this computer: if you reinstall Bookeeper, it is there.
removed.deleted: None of your Bookeeper data is left on this computer.
